name: bank_transfers
description: A small bank ledger with accounts, overdraft limits, transfers, per-account history, statements, audits and fee runs.
bugs: transfer() credits the target before debiting the source, so a failed withdrawal still leaves the deposit in place
Account uses a mutable default history=[], so all accounts share one history list
can_withdraw() uses > instead of >=, so an account cannot be drawn down exactly to its limit
